patchy¶

This is the main pypatchy module, and contains code for reading patchy particle simulations

    • simulation_ensemble.py

    • ensemble_parameter.py

    • stage.py

    • simulation_specification.py

pl¶

The name of this module stands as a testement to the principle of “don’t use a word unless you know what it means” .. automodule:: pypatchy.patchy.pl

export_stickys_staples(fp, by_row=True, incl_no_sticky=True, incl_absent=True, incl_original_patch_nums=False)¶

Exports sticky-end staples to an excel file for ordering :param by_row: if true, the excel spreadsheet will export so as to make each row on the 96-well plate (each pair of letters) correspond to a specific particle. this will go. very poorly if each DNA particle doesn’t have exactly 24 sticky candidates :param incl_no_sticky: if true, the spreadsheet will only include strands which have sticky-ends (the strands that facilitate interparticle interaction) :param incl_absent: if true, the converted will include all staples required for the origiami, not just :param incl_original_patch_nums: if true, the converter will include the patch numbers or (for palycuebes) direction names. This currently only works with polycubes.

Parameters:

  • fp (Path | str)

  • incl_no_sticky (bool)

  • incl_absent (bool)

  • incl_original_patch_nums (bool)

link_patchy_particle(p, dna)¶

Links a patchy particle to a DNA structure, rotating the structure so that the orientation of the 3’ ends of the patch strands match the position of the patches on the particle Note: PLEASE do not link multiple DNAParticle instances to the same patchy particle or vice versa!!!

Parameters:

  • p (PatchyBaseParticle) – a patchy particle to link to a DNA particle

  • dna (DNAParticle) – a dna particle to link with the patchy particle

match_patches_to_strands(p, dna)¶

Computes a rotation of this DNA particle that makes the patches on that particle line up with the 3’ ends of patch strands. :param p: a patchy particle (type) to link :type p: PLPatchyParticle :param dna: :type dna: DNAParticle

Returns:

a dataclass instance describing the relationship between the patchy particle and the dna origami

Parameters:

  • dna (DNAParticle)

Return type:

PatchyOriRelation
